root.label: UK Court of Appeal overturns Palestine Action ban ruling

events.label: UK Court of Appeal overturns Palestine Action ban ruling

slots.name: legal spending
slots.sentence: The Home Office has spent £700,000 defending proscription in the high court, according to the Independent.

slots.name: appeal outcome
slots.sentence: The total amount spent by the government will be far higher as the case has since been heard by the court of appeal, which overturned the high court’s decision that the ban was unlawful, and moves to the UK’s highest court in November.
